problem: Ground pretrained visual/language knowledge in low-level robot control while improving semantic and visual generalization beyond robot-demonstration concepts.
contribution: RT-2 co-finetunes large vision-language models with robot action-token examples and original web tasks, making action prediction part of their existing output vocabulary.
algorithm: Discretize continuous end-effector/gripper components into256bins and encode them with a terminate token. Associate bins with numeric tokens for PaLI-X or least-used vocabulary tokens for PaLM-E. Co-finetune robot/web examples and constrain decoding to valid action tokens for robot prompts.
observations: Robot camera image plus language instruction, with optional reasoning text in studied variants. Semantic reasoning is not measured physical state or force feedback.
actions: Eight entries: terminate,3position,3rotation and gripper extension. A generated terminate token signals model intention; it is not independent task verification.
embodiment_and_data: PaLI-X5B/55B and PaLM-E12B variants; real7DOF mobile manipulator with RT-1 demonstration data from13robots/17months, co-trained with web data.
experiments: Approximately6000evaluation trajectories across methods/conditions: seen/generalization tasks, emergent semantic selections, architecture/scale ablations and chain-of-thought variants. Language Table table results are simulation; selected figures additionally show physical examples.
baselines: RT-1 and other representation/policy baselines share robotic data but do not all share pretrained web knowledge/compute. Co-finetuning and model-size comparisons test individual design choices.

quantitative_result.value: Simulated Language Table: RT-2-PaLI-3B90±10 versus RT-174±13, LAVA77±4 and BC-Zero72±3. Uncertainty definition and seed count were not extracted; this table is not a physical mobile-manipulator success rate.

limitations: Web transfer does not create new physical motions; skills remain bounded by robot-data coverage. Large-model serving is expensive and can bottleneck high-frequency feedback. Chain-of-thought examples do not establish reliable causal diagnosis or safe release decisions.
code_and_license: Primary method/evaluation verified. Original model access, executable code and licenses were not audited; no local RT-2 reproduction is claimed.
hardware_adaptation: Use as context for semantic task interfaces, with explicit separation between model tokens and verified outcomes. Tens-of-billions serving is not an NX deployment plan; choose and measure an actually available policy and preserve robot-specific action constraints.

evidence_locations.supports: No new motions and compute limitations
